describes: packages/plugin/form beside the actions plugin, scripting off: the reset-form executor, the submit resolver, the script commit sink, widget activation and the widget event feed.

cases.name: the-reset-form-executor
cases.covers: A ResetForm node resets through the form: a parent name selects its descendants, exclude takes the complement without buttons or signatures, null takes every resettable field, and the batch is one engine call followed by a re-read.

cases.name: an-inert-reset
cases.covers: A selection with nothing resettable never reaches the engine and the node is inert with 'reset-form resolved no fields'; an engine with no batch door surfaces an unsupported-api diagnostic and the node is inert with its message.

nodes.detail: this engine has no form-effects batch door

diagnostics.message: reset-form: this engine has no form-effects batch door

args.message: this engine has no form-effects batch door

cases.name: a-failed-reset-fails-the-node
cases.covers: A batch whose reset entry failed or was rejected fails the node with 'reset failed'; a thrown batch fails it with the engine error.

cases.name: reset-form-action-door
cases.covers: resetFormAction reads the snapshot fresh, resets the selection as one batch and resolves the commit result; the origin defaults to 'user'. A failed list rejects.

cases.name: the-submit-resolver
cases.covers: A SubmitForm node resolves its dataset through the form: a fresh read, the ISO selection and value rules, and the explicit-listing diagnostics; charSet rides along only when the intent has one.

diagnostics.message: submit: 'button' (pushbutton) has no representable submission value in v1 — skipped
submit: 'secret' carries the NoExport flag — the veto is unconditional (ISO 12.7.6.2), skipped

args.message: submit: 'button' (pushbutton) has no representable submission value in v1 — skipped
submit: 'secret' carries the NoExport flag — the veto is unconditional (ISO 12.7.6.2), skipped

cases.name: resolve-submit-dataset-door
cases.covers: resolveSubmitDataset builds the request from the intent and the action context's origin and event; diagnostics go to the given sink; a failed read rejects.

args.message: submit: 'button' (pushbutton) has no representable submission value in v1 — skipped

cases.name: commit-script-form-effects
cases.covers: The script commit sink applies the batch, re-reads, and reloads each annotation page a changed widget is on (once, direct widgets skipped); a refused batch and an engine with no batch door both resolve as all-failed, never a throw.

cases.name: commit-sink-without-annotation
cases.covers: Without the annotation plugin the sink re-reads and has no plane to reload.

cases.name: activation-without-actions
cases.covers: Without the actions plugin activateWidget takes the form path, which is an unscripted no-op: kind 'form', status unchanged.

cases.name: activation-is-delegated
cases.covers: With the actions plugin activateWidget dispatches the widget's /A tree with a widget source and returns kind 'dispatched'; with no tree at all the form path runs, and a rootless tree counts as none.

cases.name: a-refused-activation-is-dispatched
cases.covers: A tree the dispatcher refuses (an incomplete one) still counts as dispatched: only a tree-less inert result falls back.

diagnostics.message: refused: the action tree is incomplete

cases.name: the-widget-event-feed
cases.covers: Without the annotation plugin a cursor enter hovers with unknown flags and the dispatcher resolves the tree; cursor exit hovers nothing; down, up, focus and blur dispatch directly with a widget source.

cases.name: hover-pre-checks-the-folded-annotation
cases.covers: With the annotation plugin a cursor enter on a loaded widget without enter or exit trees costs no dispatch; one with a tree hovers with its flags; an annotation that isn't a widget, or isn't loaded, hovers with unknown flags.
